mapper.delete: DELETE FROM solved_meal_dish WHERE patient_id = #{patientId} AND meal_date = #{mealDate}
DELETE FROM solved_meal_shortage WHERE patient_id = #{patientId} AND meal_date = #{mealDate}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO solved_meal_shortage (patient_id, meal_date, food_item_id) VALUES (#{patientId}, #{mealDate}, #{foodItemId})

INSERT INTO solved_meal_dish (patient_id, meal_date, recipe_id, portions, food_item_id, grams, step_text, represents_daily_remainder) VALUES (#{patientId}, #{mealDate}, #{recipeId}, #{portions}, #{foodItemId}, #{grams}, #{stepText}, #{representsDailyRemainder})
mapper.select: SELECT represents_daily_remainder FROM solved_meal_dish WHERE patient_id = #{patientId} AND meal_date = #{mealDate} LIMIT 1
SELECT food_item_id FROM solved_meal_shortage WHERE patient_id = #{patientId} AND meal_date = #{mealDate} ORDER BY food_item_id
